transcript: Overcast to kick off December, which feels about right honestly, the sky matching the mood of everyone dragging themselves back after the long weekend. Tired, that specific back-to-work-Monday tired. Nothing bad, just flat. Christmas decorations already up in the office, which is either festive or aggressive depending on how much coffee I've had.

Mundane Tuesday, work stuff, nothing worth dwelling on. Started thinking about holiday shopping and immediately regretted starting to think about holiday shopping. Ordered a couple things online, told myself that counts as progress even though it clearly doesn't fully solve the problem.

Ran in the dark this morning, actual dark, had to dig out the little headlamp thing I bought last year and mostly forgot about. Strange feeling running through empty streets with just a little pool of light bobbing in front of you, kind of peaceful actually once you get used to it. Cold enough that my hands went numb by the end. Worth it though, that clear-headed feeling afterward doesn't come from anywhere else.

Rumors flying around work today about a big push before end of year, nobody's said anything official yet but you can feel it in the air, that particular tension where everyone's suddenly being extra careful about their calendars. Hoping it's not as bad as it sounds. Otherwise ordinary Thursday, meetings, lunch at my desk, the usual.

So the rumors were right. Priya pulled a few of us in today and laid it out, there's a big push now on this project internally everyone's calling Atlas, and it needs to ship before the holidays which means the next few weeks are going to be late nights, plain and simple, she didn't sugarcoat it. Honestly I appreciate that she was direct about it instead of pretending it was going to be fine. Still, my stomach dropped a little hearing it. Already exhausted just thinking about the next month. Going to try to pace myself instead of burning out in week one, we'll see how realistic that actually turns out to be.

Sunday errands, laundry piled up all week finally dealt with, groceries for the week ahead since I know I won't have energy for it once Atlas really kicks in. Trying to get a few things squared away before the crunch really lands. Quiet otherwise, low key day.

Overcast again this Monday, and I did not sleep well at all, kept waking up around three thinking about the Atlas timeline even though there was nothing productive to do about it at three in the morning. Just lay there running through the task list in my head until the alarm finally went off. Tired in that gritty-eyed way where coffee barely touches it. Long week ahead, I can already tell.

Late night at the office, first real Atlas late night, everyone still at their desks past nine which is not normal for this team. Ordered food in for everyone, at least there's some camaraderie in the exhaustion. Made real progress on my piece of it though, which helps the anxiety a little, feels less abstract when you can see the thing actually taking shape. Heading home now, going to try to fall asleep fast because tomorrow's going to be more of the same.

Awake again in the middle of the night, mind just will not shut off with all the Atlas stuff churning in the background. Tried reading for a bit to reset but it's not really working. Going to be running on fumes today, this is officially the second bad night in a row.

Short run this morning, didn't have it in me for a full one but needed something to clear my head before another long Atlas day. Even a short one helps, twenty minutes of just moving and not thinking about deadlines. Cold and clear out, breath visible the whole way. Small mercy in an otherwise stressful stretch.

Had my first date with Sam tonight, the person Maya's been trying to set me up with for like two months. Almost cancelled honestly, been so wrung out from Atlas all week that I didn't think I had the energy to be charming for a stranger. Glad I didn't cancel though. We met at that little wine bar downtown, and it was easy, surprisingly easy, none of that awkward first-date stiffness. Talked for almost three hours about everything from terrible childhood pets to what we'd do with a completely free year. Sam's funny in this dry, unexpected way that caught me off guard a few times, actual laughing out loud in public kind of funny. Walked home afterward still smiling a little, which after this week is genuinely saying something.

Kept replaying bits of last night's date while I was out doing groceries, which I guess is a good sign. Sam texted this morning too, a follow up to something we'd talked about, small thing but it landed well. Otherwise pretty standard Saturday, errands, laundry, trying to stretch this brief calm before Atlas swallows the weekend energy again come Monday.

Rainy run this morning, properly rainy, the kind where you're soaked within the first five minutes and just have to make peace with it. Felt good regardless, one of those runs where the weather almost helps, gives you something to push against besides your own tiredness. Trying to enjoy the quiet before another Atlas week starts tomorrow.

Third bad sleep night this week, or maybe fourth, I've lost count honestly. Atlas dread just sitting on my chest every time I try to close my eyes. Rain outside instead of the usual overcast, at least that's some variety. Going to try melatonin tonight, feels like I've exhausted the other options.

Texting with Sam most of the evening, planning an actual second date for this weekend if Atlas allows it, fingers crossed on that front. Nice to have something to look forward to that isn't just deadline after deadline. Work itself was fine today, grinding but manageable, nothing catastrophic.

Wide awake at two a.m. again, this is getting genuinely rough, fourth or fifth night now where my body just refuses to stay down. Atlas timeline running on a loop behind my eyes. Going to be a hard day tomorrow running on this little sleep. Need to figure something out because this isn't sustainable.

Mom called tonight, and I could tell from the first few seconds of her voice that it wasn't just a normal check-in call. Nonna's not doing well. Her heart, mostly, some other things the doctors are watching too, and Mom was trying so hard to sound steady about it but I could hear underneath that she's scared. I sat on the floor of my kitchen for a long time after we hung up just staring at nothing. I haven't seen Nonna since last spring, and now all I can think about is every visit I could have made and didn't because I was busy or tired or telling myself there'd be more time later. There's always more time later until suddenly there isn't. I don't know what to do with this feeling except carry it around for now. Going to call Mom again tomorrow to check in properly, and I think I need to actually plan a visit soon instead of just saying I will.

Wrung out from the week, everything just catching up at once, Atlas and the sleep and now this thing with Nonna sitting heavy underneath all of it. Keeping this one short tonight. Just need to rest if I can actually manage to sleep at all.

Packing to head to my parents' for the holidays tomorrow, trying to remember everything, chargers, the gifts I actually managed to wrap, the pie dish Mom always wants back. Strange mix of feelings going into this trip, looking forward to seeing everyone but also bracing a little for how Nonna's doing news might color the whole visit. Atlas is quiet for the holiday week at least, one small mercy.
Quiet at my parents' today. Not much to say really, just sitting around, helping Mom with a few things in the kitchen, nothing eventful.
Leftovers again, took a walk around the neighborhood with Dad after lunch. Nothing much happening today, just easing through the quiet stretch between the holidays.

Back home now, clear cold day, none of the usual overcast gloom for once, actual blue sky which felt almost novel after weeks of gray. Good to be back in my own space honestly, as nice as the visit was. The Nonna thing is still sitting with me, quieter now but present, a kind of background hum. Atlas resumes properly on Monday. Trying to enjoy these last couple days of relative calm.

Easy run this morning, nothing pushed too hard, just wanted to move my body after days of sitting around and eating too much holiday food, no judgment on that though, it was worth it. Year's almost over. Feels strange looking back at everything that's happened these past couple months, the new manager, the running restart, Sam, and now this worry about Nonna sitting underneath all of it. A lot packed into not that much time.

Low key New Year's Eve with Maya and Tom, just at my place, nothing fancy, some snacks and a movie and eventually counting down on someone's phone because none of us could find the remote to turn on the actual countdown broadcast in time. Good way to end the year honestly, with the people who've been steady all year long. Not making any big resolutions this time, just hoping for a decent start to whatever's coming next.
